# Archon build plan (generated by an archon workflow run)

> **Maintainer note on M-next-1 (cookie forwarding):** the assessment's "add
> `cookie` to `FORWARD_HEADERS`" needs nuance. The DSH browser-session cookie is
> issued by *DSH* (`dsh-auth-…`, HMAC-bound to `127.0.0.1:3080`); blindly
> forwarding it to the Archon origin would be a cookie-confused-deputy risk, not
> a fix. The real requirement is that the relay must be able to present *Archon's
> own* credential to a Better-Auth-enabled Archon server — via a configurable
> `X-Archon-User` identity header, or by relaying only an Archon-scoped cookie
> when the operator pins the plugin to one Archon origin. Treat the cookie change
> as conditional/configurable, never unconditional. (Four live-server probes in
> this session confirm the endpoint claims for gaps 1–3 and 5; the cookie finding
> is a design consideration, not a bug in the current no-auth deployment.)

# dsh-archon — Build Plan (next 9 increments)

Ordered so each item ships and tests independently. Items 2–9 need **no host route changes** for their read paths — `handleRelay` (`lib/host/relay.js`) already reverse-proxies any `/archon/api/*` path, so new Archon GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE endpoints are reachable from `lib/client.js` the moment Archon exposes them. Host-side work is limited to: the header-forwarding bug (item 1), extending the existing generic `runControl` verb set in `lib/host/tools.js` (item 4), and optional `lib/host/archon-client.js` parity helpers (item 7).

## M-next-1 — Fix: forward the session cookie through the relay (S)

**Add:** In `lib/host/relay.js`, add `'cookie'` to `FORWARD_HEADERS` (currently `accept`, `content-type`, `authorization`, `x-archon-user`, `user-agent`, `if-none-match`, `if-modified-since` — no `cookie`). No change needed on the response side: the `outHeaders` copy loop in `handleRelay` already forwards every non-hop-by-hop upstream header, including `set-cookie`.

**Archon endpoints:** none new — this is a correctness fix that unblocks *every* relayed call once the target server has Better Auth enabled (see `docs/research/02` §2.6, `/api/auth/*`).

**Verify:** Extend `tests/relay-loopback.mjs` with a self-contained sub-test (no real Archon auth needed): stand up a tiny `node:http` server as a fake upstream that echoes `req.headers.cookie` back as a response header, point `handleRelay` at it (same pattern already used for the trust/auth-gate block at the end of that file), send a request with `Cookie: test=1`, and assert the fake upstream received it.

**Effort:** S.

## M-next-2 — Run detail drill-down (M)

**Add:** In `lib/client.js`:
- `ArchonConsole` state: `detailRunId`, `detailRun`, `detailLoading`.
- `openRunDetail(runId)` — `getJson("/workflows/runs/" + encodeURIComponent(runId))`, stores `{run, events}` in `detailRun`.
- `closeRunDetail()`.
- `renderRunDetail(detailRun, patch)` — a side panel: run status/timestamps/outcome header plus a scrollable event timeline (`events[]`: type, timestamp, payload).
- A "Details" button per row in `renderRuns`, next to the existing control buttons, calling `openRunDetail(run.id)`.
- Extend the dashboard-SSE `onEvent` handler (mount `useEffect`) to also re-fetch `detailRunId` when a panel is open, so live status flows into the open detail view.
- New `dsha-detail-*` CSS rules appended to the `CSS` array.

**Archon endpoint:** `GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}` → `{run, events[]}`.

**Verify:**
- `tests/relay-loopback.mjs` — add `GET /archon/api/workflows/runs/nonexistent-run-123` → 404 envelope, alongside the existing control-verb 404 sweep.
- `tests/gui-e2e.mjs` — extend its served-bundle content assertions to check the served `lib/client.js` text contains the new `dsha-detail` marker, so the drill-down is confirmed present in what's actually shipped to the browser.

**Effort:** M.

## M-next-3 — Run artifacts panel (S–M)

**Add:** In `lib/client.js`, inside the run-detail panel from M-next-2:
- `detailArtifacts` state, `loadArtifacts(runId)` (`getJson("/runs/" + id + "/artifacts")`).
- `renderArtifacts(list, runId)` — path/size/mtime rows; clicking a row fetches `GET /archon/api/artifacts/{runId}/{path}` as text and previews it inline when the response looks textual and is under a size cap, otherwise offers a plain link.

**Archon endpoints:** `GET /api/runs/{runId}/artifacts`, `GET /api/artifacts/{runId}/*`.

**Verify:** `tests/relay-loopback.mjs` — add `GET /archon/api/runs/nonexistent-run-123/artifacts` and assert Archon's real error status/envelope passes through unchanged (same passthrough-proof pattern as the existing 404 checks).

**Effort:** S–M.

## M-next-4 — Generic gate decisions (`respond`) + `signal` (S)

**Add:**
- `lib/client.js`: `controlsForRun(run)` — when `run.metadata?.approval?.decisions` is an array, render one button per declared decision (posting `respond` with `{decision}`) instead of assuming only `approve`/`reject`; `CONTROL_LABELS` gets a title-case fallback for undeclared decision strings.
- `lib/host/tools.js`: extend `CONTROL_VERBS` to add `'respond'` and `'signal'`; extend the `archon_control` tool's parameter schema (`decision`/`text` for respond; `event`/`resumeAt`/`payload` for signal) and its payload-building branch.
- `lib/host/archon-client.js`: no change — `runControl(runId, verb, payload)` is already verb-agnostic.

**Archon endpoints:** `POST /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/respond` `{decision, text?}`; `POST /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/signal` `{event, resumeAt, payload?}`.

**Verify:**
- `tests/tools-live.mjs` — add `archon_control` calls with `action: 'respond'` and `action: 'signal'` against a nonexistent run, asserting the same clean-404 pattern already used for `approve`.
- `tests/relay-loopback.mjs` — add `respond`/`signal` to the existing run-control verb sweep array.

**Effort:** S.

## M-next-5 — Runs list on the dashboard feed: filter/search/pagination (S–M)

**Add:** In `lib/client.js`, replace `loadAll()`'s `getJson("/workflows/runs?limit=30")` with `getJson("/dashboard/runs?" + query)`, `query` built from new state (`runsStatus`, `runsSearch`, `runsCodebaseId`, `runsCursor`, `runsLimit`); add a filter bar above `renderRuns` (status `<select>`, search `<input>`, codebase `<select>` sourced from `s.codebases`) and a "Load more" control wired to the response's cursor fields; surface the payload's `counts` as a small badge.

**Archon endpoint:** `GET /api/dashboard/runs?status&codebaseId&search&after&before&limit&offset`.

**Verify:** `tests/relay-loopback.mjs` — add `GET /archon/api/dashboard/runs?limit=5` → 200 with a `counts` object and a `runs` array, mirroring the existing `/workflows` shape assertion.

**Effort:** S–M.

**Add:**

## M-next-8 — Workflow definition viewer, read-only (M) — SUPERSEDED

**Status:** superseded by the **Studio** mode, which embeds Archon's own
visual workflow builder (`/console/builder`, shipped in Archon v0.7.0 from the
Studio builder PR series) in a frame. Viewing and editing a definition happen in
Archon's canvas, not in plugin code; the plugin builds the deep link and offers
project and workflow pickers plus an Edit-in-Studio button per workflow card. A
first cut re-implemented the builder in plain JavaScript; it was removed because
it duplicated, with fewer features, what the Archon server already serves. The
frame is covered by the offline `tests/builder-render.mjs` suite.

**Add:** In `lib/client.js`, add a "View" action per row in `renderWorkflows`, calling `getJson("/workflows/" + name + "?cwd=&source=")` and rendering the returned `definition` as a read-only `<pre>` block in a side panel (reuse the panel shell built for M-next-2).

**Archon endpoint:** `GET /api/workflows/{name}?cwd=&source=`.

**Verify:** `tests/relay-loopback.mjs` — add `GET /archon/api/workflows/archon-assist?source=bundled` → 200 with a `definition` object (bundled default, same "always present" assumption the file already relies on for `/workflows`).

**Effort:** M.

## M-next-9 — Conversation housekeeping + file attachments (S)

**Add:** In `lib/client.js`'s `renderChatPane`: a rename control (`PATCH /conversations/{id} {title}`), a confirm-then-`DELETE /conversations/{id}` (soft-delete; clears `activeConvId` if it was the deleted one, then `loadConversations()`); a `<input type="file" multiple>` in the composer, and change `sendMessage()` to build `FormData` (`message` + up to 5 files) and skip the JSON `content-type` header when files are attached.

**Archon endpoints:** `PATCH /api/conversations/{id}` `{title}`; `DELETE /api/conversations/{id}`; `POST /api/conversations/{id}/message` multipart (`message` + up to 5 files, ≤10 MB each).

**Verify:** `tests/relay-loopback.mjs` already creates and PATCHes a throwaway conversation — extend it with a `DELETE` on that same conversation, asserting it drops out of the subsequent list, plus a multipart POST of one tiny text file to `/message` asserting `{accepted}`.

**Effort:** S.

---

## Explicitly out of scope for this plan

- Any change to the Archon server, its DB schema, or its REST/SSE contracts.
- Any change to DSH core (`slots`, `webServer`, `connection` services) — this plugin only consumes those contracts.
- Any builder feature at all — Studio frames Archon's builder, so canvas, validation, and save behaviour are Archon's and are not re-implemented here. The unmerged upstream follow-ups (marketplace submission, builder copilot) need Archon server changes and would arrive by running an Archon build that includes them.
- Config/model-tier/alias editing (`PATCH /api/config/*`) and per-user AI-prefs/provider-key/GitHub-identity management (`/api/auth/me/*`, `/api/auth/providers/*`, `/api/auth/github`) — real gaps, but deferred past this 9-item pass; the provider/auth surface only becomes usable once M-next-1's cookie fix is verified against a live Better-Auth-enabled server.
- Driving non-web platform conversations (Telegram/Slack/Discord) — those adapters are inbound-only and unreachable via REST.
- Any API-key-based auth scheme for the relay — Archon has none; auth is cookie- or trusted-header-based only.
- `/internal/git-credential` and container-isolation resume — internal/unsupported paths, not meant for a UI layer.
